slide.title: Implemented: explicit inventory format 2 gate
slide.takeaway: Format 2 exists only after an explicit marker; legacy revisions stay byte-identical and read unspecified, and older readers refuse instead of dropping content.

item.label: Legacy history reads unspecified
item.description: Existing Component/System revisions keep their bytes and have no evidence IDs. Their intent reads unspecified, never inferred from code, lifecycle or age; the legacy validation rules are unchanged.

references.note: EffectiveIntent reports explicit intent or unspecified for legacy revisions.
The original format-1 rules, which also refuse IDs, baseline or delivery without intent.

criterion_links.rationale: Records expose explicit proposed/implemented intent per revision and an explicit unspecified value for legacy history; displays and queries are sibling slices.
A legacy entity with or without evidence is not relabeled proposed or implemented; the stored assessment stays separate from code.

item.label: Explicit adoption marker
item.description: inventory adopt-format --format 2 writes ___inventory/format.json under the Saga lock and rewrites no record. Only format 2 exists; an unknown marker value is refused.

references.note: AdoptInventoryFormat writes only the marker and replays when already adopted.
readInventoryFormat treats absence as format 1 and refuses unsupported formats.

criterion_links.rationale: Adoption preserves every committed revision unchanged; new structures are only ever appended as new revisions.

item.label: Reader and writer gate
item.description: LoadInventory reads format 1 and 2 kinds in a fixed order and refuses format-2 kinds or intent without the marker. After adoption a new Component/System revision must state intent.

references.note: LoadInventory: kind directories, marker, per-kind format gate and structural validation.
formatAdmits refuses format-2 writes before adoption and intent-less writes after it.

criterion_links.rationale: After adoption every new revision carries an explicit intent, so the selected revision status is never silently unspecified.

item.label: Compatibility tests
item.description: Tests cover legacy intent before and after adoption, refusal of intent and data entities without the marker, a future format 3 and an unknown inventory directory.

references.note: Legacy records read unspecified before and after adoption.
Format-2 content without the marker and unsupported markers are refused.

criterion_links.rationale: The tests prove adoption and reading never rewrite or reinterpret committed history.
